findings.claim: CI's tests job ran pytest on tests/ only, so kmaudit's tests never ran in CI.
GUIDANCE and PREVIOUS_HASHES must change together and nothing enforces it; deferred by loopctl to ticket kmaudit-package-reviewer-f2.
kmctl was named as the actor in kmaudit's docstring, two skills and the review page.

verdict.text: Both findings sent back are fixed, and the fixes broke nothing.
CI now runs pytest at the repository root, which collects the same 1379 tests as the gate, kmaudit's 231 among them.
The stale "kmctl" wording is gone from kmaudit's docstring, both skills and the review page.
f2 stays open as non-blocking hardening, deferred to its own ticket.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format, tests, integration and eval rows r1 to r6 pass, "stamp green: d57c7a1c289ecd1b49fbda3208328f66910e7c3c11d739490795e7d582273556".
f1: I read the pinned action (toiminnot actions/pytest/action.yaml at dc32088c) through the GitHub API.
It runs `uv sync --all-extras --all-groups`, then `uv run pytest "$TESTS_DIRECTORY" -v ... -m "$TESTS_MARKERS"`, so `directory: .` is one quoted path argument.
The dev group holds `kmaudit[tracing]` as a uv workspace member, so the sync installs it.

I ran `uv run pytest . --collect-only -q -m "not integration"` in the worktree: 1379/1393 collected, 231 under packages/kmaudit/tests, the same count as the gate's bare `uv run pytest` (hidden folders such as .loop/ and .okf/ are skipped by pytest's default norecursedirs, and no testpaths is set).
tests/test_ci.py: the pytest-job test pins `directory: "."` and runs a collect-only on that directory, asserting test ids rooted in both `packages` and `tests`.
Pointing the job back at `tests` would fail both asserts.

f3: `__init__.py`'s docstring now says kmaudit; line 8 of both extract-claims and write-checks SKILL.md says "kmaudit calls no model here"; a grep of ui.html for kmctl finds nothing, and its user-facing strings name kmaudit.
The remaining `kmctl-claims-extractor` and `kmctl-check-writer` mentions are agent names, which this ticket does not rename.
The skills' evals.json and results.md also moved to the kmaudit command names, and results.md says the runs predate the rename.
f1: resolved in .github/workflows/ci.yml and tests/test_ci.py, as above.
f2: open, non-blocking hardening.
It was not sent back this round; loopctl deferred it to the stub ticket kmaudit-package-reviewer-f2.
f3: resolved in packages/kmaudit/src/kmaudit/__init__.py, both SKILL.md files and packages/kmaudit/src/kmaudit/ui.html.
The new test_ci check only looks at collected ids, so a collection error in one tree that still left some ids from it would not fail the test.
The tests gate would catch that error anyway, so I do not raise it.
